rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something takes up time, space, or capacity.

example.english: These things occupy the whole table.
example.traditional: 呢張枱擺咗啲雜物，佔用晒成個位。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 baai2 zo2 di1 zaap6 mat6 zim3 jung6 saai3 sing4 go3 wai2

rows.note: Pick this when a person or task keeps someone occupied or tied up for a period of time.

example.english: That customer can occupy me all morning, leaving me no time to eat.
example.traditional: 嗰個客可以纏住我成朝，搞到我冇時間食飯。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 haak3 ho2 ji5 cin4 zyu6 ngo5 sing4 ziu1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for people living or residing in a place, rather than for merely taking up space.

example.english: We occupy a flat in Sha Tin.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 saa1 tin4

rows.note: Use this when an army or state takes and holds control of a territory.

example.english: The enemy forces occupy the city now, so civilians have to evacuate.
example.traditional: 敵軍而家佔領咗座城，市民要撤離。
example.jyutping: dik6 gwan1 ji4 gaa1 zim3 ling5 zo2 zo6 sing4 si5 man4 jiu3 cit3 lei4
